⏪️⏪️In this episode we rewind to 2023, the very beginning of our vanlife journey in Finland, and do something we’d never done before: we visit a protected nature reserve with our motorhome for the first time. 🚐🌲🌳 Incredibly beautiful grove reserve in Huittinen was the perfect place to start, as it’s an easy and van-friendly spot to spend the night while being surrounded by nature.🌳🐦🐑

Wild parking in Finland is easy and well tolerated, if you remember to respect nature and other people.🌲

⏩️⏩️Fast 
forward to 2026, and we’re already deep into overlanding and Morocco travel, cruising through the country in a two-vehicle convoy. 🚐🚐🌵

This time we mixed things up with a slightly different kind of overnight stay and ended up sleeping in a Marjane supermarket parking lot.🛒🛍

GzRt8n0ir3M.title: Lost Petroglyphs, Off-Road Chaos & a Sahara Sandstorm | Campervan Morocco
GzRt8n0ir3M.description:
From the remote village of Icht, we head deeper into southern Morocco in our self-build campervan. Our journey takes us to the ruined area and palmerie near Agadir Owzro (Akka) before continuing on to Tata, where we celebrate Sarah’s birthday in true adventure style.

For the birthday adventure, we set out to find the ancient petroglyphs near Akka — but it quickly turns into a real off-road challenge. Narrow village streets, a rough 5km off-road track, and a navigation mistake leave us almost 2 miles from our destination. We park up and hike the rest, eventually discovering the petroglyphs after searching the wrong hill first.

Back in Icht the next day, our plans are halted by a powerful Sahara sandstorm, forcing us to shelter in the van as the air becomes hard to breathe and our eyes sting from blowing sand. Once the storm passes, we clean up and prepare for our next Morocco adventure.

This episode is full of vanlife Morocco, desert travel, off-road driving, hiking, and unexpected challenges — exactly why we love travelling by campervan in North Africa.

Da Tan Tan Plage partiamo senza grandi aspettative: l’idea era fare pochi chilometri e fermarci lungo la strada.

Guardiamo il meteo, vediamo il sole più a sud e decidiamo di rimetterci in viaggio per raggiungere il caldo e il cielo azzurro.
Quello che non ci aspettavamo era lo scenario che ci siamo trovati davanti: una strada lunghissima in mezzo alle dune, un paesaggio completamente nuovo per noi, quasi irreale.

xK33thNEDAo.title: 500 KM ALONE Near Mauritania Border 🇲🇦 White Desert & Ocean Road S1, EP26
xK33thNEDAo.description:
Today I continue my overland journey in Morocco driving from Dakhla towards the Mauritania border.

This road was one of the most unreal drives of my life — white sand everywhere, empty roads, and for almost 30 minutes I didn’t see a single car. Driving next to the Atlantic Ocean with nothing but silence and wind felt like another planet.

Later in the evening I stopped at a small local restaurant and enjoyed one of the best chicken tagines I’ve ever had. Ending the day with a beautiful sunset by the coast made this journey unforgettable.

Traveling alone across Africa in my Toyota Hilux camper is not just about destinations, it’s about these rare moments of peace, isolation, and discovery.

📍Route: Dakhla → Mauritania Border
🚙 Vehicle: Toyota Hilux Camper

zIjo5V-wcLg.description:
Dans cette étape de notre voyage, la route nous emmène entre imprévus, découvertes et paysages complètement inattendus.
D’un village de pêcheurs authentique à la côte de Taghazout, en passant par la chaleur, les dunes et la route, ce voyage nous réserve bien plus que ce que l’on imaginait.

On parle aussi du travail autour de l’arganier et de l’huile d’argan, du quotidien local, des parkings pour camping-cars à Taghazout, avant de terminer dans un lieu surprenant : une oasis nichée dans la vallée du Paradis, avec un bivouac chez Momo.

Une vidéo pensée comme un carnet de route, pour partager la réalité du voyage en camping-car au Maroc, donner des repères utiles et montrer que les plus belles surprises se trouvent souvent là où on ne les attend pas.

Si vous voyagez en camping-car ou que vous préparez un road trip au Maroc, cette étape pourrait bien vous inspirer.
